core_insight.source_excerpt: Enterprises often struggle with a lack of telemetry to pinpoint AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant drift in systems and human resources.
core_insight.why_different: Narma focuses on an 'Enterprise Agentic Brain' that orchestrates existing foundation models through a 'Work Graph' to identify and execute high-ROI AI automation opportunities, rather than developing new foundation models.
core_insight.if_wrong: If AI-first companies cannot effectively scale AI automation even with precise telemetry, reliable ROI, and drift mitigation, or if Narma's approach fails to deliver these, then the core premise of Narma would be invalidated. It would essentially mean that the fundamental issues preventing enterprise AI automation are not resolvable through Narma's proposed layered architecture and 'Work Graph' approach, or that these issues are not as critical as assumed.

raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the prospect of building a single, comprehensive system that can continuously observe work, intelligently decide AI actions, and autonomously build agents to provide "Continuous AI lift" for AI-first companies.
things_that_must_work: Accuracy of desktop sensors in capturing work patterns
Effectiveness of the "Brain" in detecting employee intent and task value
Stability and reliability of automatically generated AI agents
Enterprise security and compliance for data capture and agent deployment
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layer architecture. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) is a "Brain" that detects employee intent, business value of tasks, and "drift." Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. It uses existing foundation models and focuses on building a "Work Graph" to identify areas for AI assistance and resource optimization.
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's distinction lies in its comprehensive, three-layered "Enterprise Agentic Brain." Unlike solutions that might focus on specific AI tasks or model development, Narma provides an end-to-end system that observes work patterns, intelligently identifies AI opportunities, and autonomously deploys and monitors agents using existing foundation models. Its focus on the "Work Graph" and "Continuous AI lift" offers a novel approach to scaling AI automation by directly addressing the challenges of telemetry, ROI, and drift in AI-first enterprises.

bottleneck.current_blocker: Building the core technology stack and validating its ability to accurately observe work patterns, intelligently detect intent, and reliably generate/deploy AI agents for high-ROI opportunities.
bottleneck.relaxed_by: Successful development and internal testing of the three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) to demonstrate its technical feasibility and initial efficacy.
bottleneck.why_it_blocks: Without a functional system that can demonstrate its core capabilities, Narma cannot effectively go to market, secure customers, or prove its value proposition.

raw.thesis: Narma is developing an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" to enable AI-first companies to scale AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layer architecture: an "Observe" layer with desktop sensors to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" that acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent and task value, and an "Execution Layer" or "Agent Factory" that autonomously generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities. This system leverages existing foundation models, focusing on creating a "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI intervention. It aims to provide continuous AI lift by observing work, deciding AI actions, and building agents automatically. Narma is for AI-first companies facing challenges with AI savings telemetry, unreliable ROI measurement, and system/human resource drift. The founder's immediate goal is not specified, but the venture appears to be at an idea stage, moving towards building out this complex system. Narma seeks to complement existing foundation models by providing the orchestration and intelligence layer necessary for practical, scalable enterprise AI automation, rather than replacing them.
